text:
Rhea (Growth): Heads-up: planning launch posts + webinar follow-up experiment next sprint. Want to tie social launch messaging to two inbound routing flows and a small credit incentive test. Goal: increase demo requests from webinar regs by 30% and lift API activations by 20%.

Noah (Sales Ops): sounds good. Routing question — do we route all webinar registrants to SDRs or only those who redeem credits / request demo?

Rhea (Growth): test two routing arms: Arm 1 = standard (no immediate SDR ping, nurture emails). Arm 2 = fast-route (immediate SDR ping if they redeem credits or click demo CTA). We'll randomize at registration.

Priya (Content): for social and launch posts we need 2 narrative frames: "Benchmark narrative" (showcase latency/cost examples for devs) and "Quickstarter narrative" (show quick wins with prompt templates). We should A/B these on LinkedIn/Twitter.

Diego (Analytics): measurement plan: 14d window from reg. Primary events: `webinar_reg`,`post_reg_email_sent`,`credit_redeemed`,`first_api_call`,`demo_request_clicked`,`sdr_contacted`. I'll build a funnel and a benchmark chart comparing baseline metrics (last 3 webinars).

Rhea (Growth): credit schema: small incentive (40 credits) vs boosted (120 credits) vs control (0). We'll test credit x routing interaction.

Noah (Sales Ops): actionable rule: if `credit_redeemed` AND `demo_request_clicked` -> SDR ping with highest priority. If multiple triggers, prioritize event order. Also need a HubSpot property `mkt_experiment_arm`.

Priya (Content): copy snippets for social: 
"Benchmark: See how teams cut inference costs with Redwood — join our webinar & try 40 credits."
"Quickstarter: Build a search or docs assistant in <30m using our prompt pack + 120 credits."

Rhea (Growth): email subject lines (short):
A) "You're registered — grab your starter credits"
B) "Webinar + templates to ship faster"

Diego (Analytics): sample SQL for the dashboard (pseudocode):
```
SELECT cohort, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as regs, SUM(case when first_api_call then 1 else 0 end) as activations FROM events WHERE event_time between $start and $end GROUP BY cohort;
```

Priya (Content): for the post-reg landing we should surface 3 vertical prompt quickstarts (support, search, sales). That should boost relevance.

Noah (Sales Ops): Zapier mapping: add `mkt_experiment_arm`, `credit_tier`, `workshop_rsvp` to HubSpot. zapier-bot: will push mapping after this thread.

launch-bot: experiment created: `exp_1756002468_launch_social_inbound_credits` — arms: control/40/120; routing arms: standard/fast-route. Dry-run scheduled Mon 08:30 PT.

zapier-bot: mapping queued -> HubSpot property sync: https://hub.company/settings/props/mkt_experiment_arm

Diego (Analytics): timeline check: tracking plan by EOD Friday, dashboard by Wed next week, dry-run Monday, full launch Thursday. I'll also add a benchmark narrative slide comparing cost/latency for our top 3 models to use in social creative.

Rhea (Growth): tagging owners: Diego = dashboard & benchmark slides, Priya = social + email copy & prompt packs, Noah = routing + HubSpot mapping. Sync Friday 3pm for tracking signoff.

Priya (Content): will drop LinkedIn copy + images in #marketing-assets and attach prompt pack drafts.

Noah (Sales Ops): note: SDRs want a 1-line context in the ping: "Reg from webinar — redeemed credits: <tier> — interested in quick demo". I'll add to the Zap message template.

Rhea (Growth): love it. If anyone spots edge cases (duplicate regs, multi-email), flag here. Need minimal friction from social click -> reg -> API path. :eyes:
